Transmigrating into the body of a princess of the Great Xia Dynasty, and even as a wheelchair-bound girl, Mu Qinglan felt a bit panicked.
This was because this was the game world she had deeply explored in her previous life, and the early-stage villain boss was none other than her current biological father, Prince Qi.
Moreover, the entire mansion would be completely annihilated in the near future.
Her prospects could be described as bleak.
However, there was also good news. As a transmigrator, Mu Qinglan knew many supernatural secrets that only players knew, as well as many secrets hidden deep in the hearts of game characters that hadn’t been exposed yet.
The secrets of NPCs were generally not that important and difficult to leverage.
But those future villain bosses…
Hmm, there was potential there.
The game company knew players’ preferences well—each prominent villain boss was more attractive than the last: ice-cold beauty, silent loli, energetic little sister, cunning fox, even the imperial princess. They had it all, making anyone say that 2D characters were truly enjoyable.
So, she had no choice but to follow her desires.
“Miss Villainess, you wouldn’t want your secrets to be known by others, would you?”
associated_names: 就这么喜欢我吗？反派小姐

122060.synopsis:
A boy named Yohan was abandoned deep in the mountains by his parents and raised by wolves.
One day, he comes down to the city after a fateful encounter.
From that moment on, many new experiences await him…
This is the story of a special boy with infinite talent who keeps growing through new experiences
The beginning of his exciting Reset Life!

123084.synopsis:
“Actually, I love Lydia.” 
The man who had been Eleanor’s fiancé for two years confessed that he loved her younger sister.
It wasn’t surprising.
Because Eleanor’s younger sister, Lydia, is the female lead of this world. 
It’s been 11 years since she possessed the extra older sister of the female lead. 
Male leads who pick fights all the time.
Parents who only care about their younger sister.
Three fiancés who broke off their engagements because they liked Lydia.
Everyone in this world thinks and acts with Lydia at the center! 
After three broken engagements, her reputation as a noble lady has plummeted.
Eleanor, tired of everything, quits being the extra older sister of the female lead and leaves to find freedom. 
* 
Or so she thought, but strange things happened.
As soon as she decided to give up everything and go her own way, men who like her, not Lydia, started appearing. 
“I’ve always been interested in you. You were just too oblivious to notice.”
“I am no longer the person I used to be. So please, give me a chance.”
“Tell me. Can you really say that you never knew my feelings, not even once?”
“I knew you first, Sister. So please, take my hand.” 
And the strangest of them all… 
“You’re not thinking of leaving me again, are you? Please don’t. I need you.”
“I regret it. Hurting you with the same words as that man.” 
He, who had said he liked Lydia, was suddenly clinging to her.

124364.synopsis:
“D-Do you know me?”
Lily, who had been trapped in a temple and exploited by the high priest, had lost all hope after repeated failed escape attempts.
Then, the Little Duke of the North suddenly appeared before her.
But… something’s strange about him.
“How could I not know you, Miss Hegelstern?”
She’s sure they’ve never met before—so why does he act like he knows her?
“Young master, are you… crying?”
“…No. Why would I cry?”
He weeps sorrowfully when he sees her hurt.
And even begs when she tries to leave:
“Just stay until your arm heals. Let me at least treat it—please, I’m begging you! I won’t ask you to stay longer. Just… please….”
Held back by his desperate pleas and gentle obsession, Lily is torn.
Little Duke, why on earth are you doing this to me?!

124876.synopsis:
Kill me. Before I destroy the world.
After over a thousand regressions, So Taejun has had enough.
Cursed, exhausted, and ready to die, he makes his final decision—only to fall into hell itself, dragging the Demon King down with him.
But death doesn’t bring peace.
It brings him.
“At first, I was going to break your mind, preserve your body, and hang you behind my bed.
But now… I want to see how long you can last.”
This wasn’t the ending Taejun had in mind.
“The one who loves you more than anyone in this world… is me.”
Love? No. This is obsession wearing its skin.
When Taejun finally stops trying to rewind time, everything spirals.
The Demon King refuses to let go.
Old comrades return—possessive, unstable, and dangerously fixated.
And Taejun, supposedly memory-wiped, is back on Earth with a smile that hides something feral.
They think he’s harmless now.
They think he’s broken.
They’re wrong.
They forgot who he used to be.
And he’s about to remind them.
[Your future—] 
[Would you like to choose it yourself? (o`ꇴ´o)] 
Time for payback.
Big, messy, and apocalyptic.

125900.synopsis:
The alien ladies of the post-apocalyptic world are gradually entering their mating season.
(Completed) Ashu, the snake woman, sensed a change in the wind, a sweet and cloying scent.
She writhed her serpentine body, and on the eighth floor of an abandoned building, she found a girl curled into a ball.
Her abdomen was swollen, as if about to lay eggs.
Ashu narrowed her vertical pupils, her wet tongue flicking across the girl’s neck.
Are they my eggs?
They are my eggs.
【Overbearing and independent snake x delicate and beautiful orphan girl】
(Completed) When Lu Er Ya was captured by the swarm of bees in the southern forest, she thought she was doomed.
But after being bathed, cleansed, disarmed, and given royal jelly, she was brought to the queen’s hive.
There, she saw her girlfriend, who had been dead for three years.
She was still gentle and quiet, her eyes filled with love, and a desire to devour Lu Er Ya.
Her girlfriend suffered brain damage during her evolution into a queen bee, forgetting everything between them.
Lu Er Ya loves her, but also fears her.

158924.synopsis:
Humanity, which had built a brilliant civilization in the 28th century, was defeated by the sudden invasion of monsters.
The last survivor of the 28th century, Barbarian Mason Park.
He takes his first great step onto the chaotic Earth of the 21st century!

183244.synopsis:
Although Li Xiao is a prince, he was born to a second wife. In his previous life, he was suspected and ostracized by his brother, the King, and kept far away from the royal family since childhood. He never expected that rearing a tiger would bring calamity, almost leading to the destruction of the country.
Reborn at the age of eighteen, he hides his identity and enters an enemy country’s military academy, hoping to unite with his old partner from his previous life to change his country’s passive situation.
As soon as he arrives in the enemy country, he is targeted by a troublesome alpha. The other party is breathtakingly beautiful, ruthless in his methods, and bears a striking resemblance to the King of the enemy country.
Song Jin: You want to see His Majesty?
Li Xiao: You have a way?
Song Jin: He doesn’t see outsiders. If you want to see him, you have to marry me first.
Li Xiao: …
Imperial Prince Song Jin is beautiful but ruthless. While receiving exchange students, he encounters another stinking idiot trying to get close to his brother. Yet, unfortunately, that person’s face was exactly his type, and the mysteries surrounding him unconsciously attracted his attention.
Song Jin: You can see His Majesty, but you have to marry me first.
He thought this would persuade the other party to back off.
Li Xiao: Then—let’s hurry up.
Song Jin: …?
Shortly after Li Xiao returned to his country, Song Jin followed him.
Song Jin: Weren’t you looking for my brother for reinforcements?
Li Xiao: …
#Originally wanted to borrow the east wind, but borrowed an evil wind instead#
#Is it too late to return the goods now?#

186572.synopsis:
Cecil, an ordinary employee at a village inn, suddenly regains the memories of his past life. He realizes he is inside a game, and he is nothing more than a simple inn NPC. 
Since he’s just an extra anyway, he wants to save up some money, travel around, and live a comfortable life. But for that to happen, the protagonist must save the world first. 
Since he at least had a sub-quest to offer, he merely intended to prepare a special potion for the hero. 
However, the very first person he encounters is the protagonist’s rival character, Derek Irnian. And he somehow ends up continuously entangled with him.
***
Derek let out a soft smirk. However, it didn’t seem like the gesture lightened the mood or meant he had any intention of giving up.
“There’s no need for that. I can just finish it off right now.”
“Ugh!”
Derek roughly yanked his sleeve from my grasp and strode forward. He never once looked back. I wasn’t sure if he was ignoring me because he had already warned me to leave, or if he was genuinely angry.
“Ugh…”
I couldn’t just walk away now. There is absolutely no way Derek can defeat that monster on his own. The storyline of this world has already dictated it. Yet, the thought of actually stepping up to help him fight the beast made me hesitate.
And for good reason. Because that monster…
“Is my sub-quest!”

198348.synopsis:
[Kingdom Building • Development • Exploration • Evolution • Lord] 
By chance, Shen Xing enters an incredibly realistic game.
Inside, players can upgrade buildings, recruit troops, explore the endless mist, and expand their territories.
The game is brutally difficult.
At the very start, Shen Xing awakens a hidden talent:
Life Sacrifice Evolution.
By sacrificing his own attributes, he can evolve his troops into more powerful forms.
But after some experimentation, he discovers an unbelievable loophole—
He can exploit the talent to evolve his troops without paying any price at all.
From then on, one powerful unit after another emerges from his territory.
